description: This file contains extension methods for rendering ContentItems and other objects in OrchardCore, including display and console logging functionalities.

classes.name: ContentOrchardRazorHelperExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for rendering ContentItems and objects in OrchardCore.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously builds and displays a ContentItem using OrchardCore display helpers.

methods.name: ConsoleLog
methods.description: Renders an object as a JavaScript console log in HTML, handling various object types.

methods.name: ConvertContentItem
methods.description: Converts a ContentItem to a JsonObject with its properties.

methods.name: ConvertContentPart
methods.description: Converts a ContentPart to a JsonObject including its ContentItem and Content.
